description: R08 final functional closeout for the Microsoft input parser C0 contract. Rust now owns all 32 C0 vectors, including the input-only trailing ESC ProcessString boundary rule, US-layout virtual-key/scan-code enrichment, Ctrl+C dispatch, Backspace DEL translation, Tab/Enter/Escape exceptions, and Ctrl/Shift modifier semantics.

entries.notes: The portable input owner reproduces Microsoft's complete 0x00-0x1f matrix. LayoutMappedInputDispatch supplies the deterministic US-layout VkKeyScanW/MapVirtualKeyW fixture fields, while process_input_utf16_chunk supplies Microsoft's input-only trailing ESC chunk-boundary behavior without changing output parser semantics.
